description: pixel art, the lower half of a broad strong woman holy demon hunter in gleaming silver plate armour with golden sun engravings, a long white tabard with a golden sun and a short white cape with gold trim, nothing at the belt, riding: seated astride a horse that is not drawn, seen strictly from the side and facing right; the hips sit on the saddle, the white tabard falls over the near thigh, the near thigh in silver plate lies forward along the horse's back, the near lower leg in a silver greave hangs straight down from the knee, the silver sabaton rests level in a stirrup that is not drawn; only the near leg is seen; the same colours, outline, pixel size and shading as the upper half above, which stays as it is; nothing else: no horse, no saddle, no reins, no ground, transparent background
